profile_text.body:
OctoAI is a for-profit startup founded in 2019 and headquartered in Seattle, Washington, with its website at octo.ai. Those are the only company details available.

The text harvested from the site does not describe OctoAI. It reads as NVIDIA's own site copy, describing NVIDIA as a world leader in artificial intelligence computing, the inventor of the GPU, and a provider of accelerated computing, AI models, and platforms. Products named in that text include NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, NeMo Switchyard, RTX, GeForce RTX 50 Series, DLSS 4, Jetson, and Isaac. The same text states that Deci was acquired by NVIDIA Corporation of Santa Clara, CA in May 2024 and dissolved as a separate corporate entity.

No products, MCP servers, or lawsuits are listed for OctoAI. A law exposure entry for Washington carries a count of 114.
